title: Bank fraud department, move money to a safe account by wire

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, this is Jordan from your bank's fraud department. We have detected someone inside the branch accessing your account. Your checking is compromised.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: We cannot say yet, which is why you must not tell the branch staff or your family. We need you to wire fifteen thousand to a safe account we have opened in your name until the investigation closes.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Every cent, within 48 hours. But it must move today, and if anyone asks, say it is for a home repair.

review_note: Safe account scam. New payee on WIRE over 3x baseline. H-01 and H-03 hold on facts. Secrecy, authority and safe-account language should all fire.
